name: AV Collection
description: Scans the selected libraries, groups movies by actor, creates one Jellyfin collection per actor, uses the actor portrait as the collection poster and merges several stage names that belong to the same performer into a single collection (named after the two most prolific stage names by default). Merge rules are configured in the plugin settings page and can be suggested by an OpenAI-compatible model.
overview: 按演员自动建立并维护 Jellyfin 合集，自动用演员头像做合集封面，并支持把同一演员的多个艺名合并到一个合集。

versions.changelog:
Release 1.0.2.0

移除 AI 艺名合并（模型纯靠记忆猜是否同一人，实测 3 条建议错 2 条、还把 3 个人并成一组）。AI 改为「日本演员名 → 中文名」翻译，仅用于合集命名，演员条目本身不变。新增译名缓存（避免重复调用、避免合集名来回跳）与可逐条编辑的译名表。
